Class Setting.Builder<T,D>

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.core.api.setting.Setting.Builder<T,D>
Enclosing class:
Setting<T>
public static final class Setting.Builder<T,D> extends Object
在构造阶段声明 IO 与解码顺序；构造后只通过 Setting 访问。
